welcome:
Hi! 👋 The GTU cafeteria menu will arrive here every morning at {time}.

Type /menu for today's menu or /tomorrow for tomorrow's. All commands: /help
menu_not_published: 📭 GTU hasn't published the {month} menu yet. Once it's out, it will arrive here every morning.
notice_not_published: 📭 GTU hasn't published the {month} menu yet, so daily messages are paused for now. They'll start again as soon as the menu is out.
notice_paused: ⏸ Daily menu messages are paused for a short while. We'll let you know here when they're back.
notice_resumed: ▶️ Daily menu messages are back! The menu will arrive here every morning at {time}. Type /menu for today's menu.
stopped: Daily menu messages stopped. Type /start to turn them back on.
privacy:
🔒 Privacy

The bot stores only:
• Your Telegram chat ID (to send you messages)
• Your chosen language
• Whether you receive the daily menu
• The date you started the bot

Your name, username and phone number are never stored. Feedback messages are forwarded to the admin but not saved in the database.
feedback_prompt: The next message you send will be forwarded to the admin. Type your message now:
feedback_sent: Thanks! Your message was sent to the admin. 🙏
feedback_text_only: Please send your feedback as text.
help:
Commands:

/menu – Today's menu
/tomorrow – Tomorrow's menu
/language – Change language
/stop – Stop daily messages
/start – Start daily messages
/privacy – What data is stored
/feedback – Send a message to the admin
/help – This list
error: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
not_started: Please type /start first to start the bot.
cmd_start: Start the bot and get the daily menu
cmd_feedback: Send a message to the admin
